_doc: XP for activities beyond lessons, tricks, defense and missions (those pay their own XP in their results; story 10.2, characters/Progress.js). When `event` fires, every kid it names gets `amount` XP through the xp.add action: payload.players (a list), else payload.player, else player 0. `filter` must match payload fields exactly. Levels come from state.json (xpPerLevel, maxLevel); every level-up emits level:up and is celebrated, and data/attr-growth.json lets a level-up grow stamina.
